children: said its board has authorized a normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 10M common shares for a maximum of C$2.25B.
represents approximately 2.6% of the bank’s 382.84M common shares outstanding as of Sept. 1, 2026.
The bid is subject to approval from the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions Canada and the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Subject to regulatory and exchange approval, the program is expected to begin around Oct. 9, 2026, and end no later than Oct. 8, 2027.
The bid will provide the bank with additional flexibility to manage capital.
